name: Aapki Antara
description: Aapki Antra was a Zee TV soap opera which premiered on June 1, 2009 and ended on February 18, 2010. The story is about a girl, Antara, who is diagnosed with autism and who positively affects the lives of those she encounters during her life.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Anuradha Rai gets her daughter Antara ready for school. Antaras classmates play pranks on her, but she never reacts. Antara answers all the questions correctly, but does not respond to her teacher. Her schoolmates try to irritate Antara by making noise. In an attempt to avoid them, she bumps into a boy, who falls and gets hurt. Anuradhas friend Kaveri asks her to call up Aditya who is Antaras father because it is difficult for a woman to manage everything alone. The school Principal tells Anuradha that she cant allow Antara to attend the school anymore because of her strange behaviour. Doctor tells Anuradha that Antara is suffering from a mental condition called autism. She suggests her to take Antara to Mumbai for treatment. Anuradha is lost in her own thoughts when she suddenly meets with an accident.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The police try to contact someone through Anuradhas mobile. Vidya is confident that her husband Aditya will surely get the promotion this time, but he does not have much hope. Their neighbours son Billu comes to Adityas house for breakfast as usual. Vidya reminds Aditya that they have to go for dinner to her parents house. Adityas boss warns him to bear the consequences if he does not sanction his brother-in-laws loan. Adityas friend Sameer tries to persuade him for the same, but he refuses to give up his principles. The police inform Aditya about Anuradhas accidental death. Aditya lies to Vidya that he is going to Pune for some official work. Kaveri tells Aditya that Antara is his daughter.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Aditya Questions Kaveri About Antara’s Strange Behaviour. As Requested By Anuradha In Her Letter, Aditya Takes The Responsibility Of Antara And Decides To Take Her With Him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: On Reaching Mumbai, Aditya Goes To Sameer’s Place And Tells Him The Truth. Aditya Wants To Tell The Truth To Vidya, But Sameer Stops Him. A Nervous Vidya Asks Aditya About The Kid.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Aditya Accepts Vidya’s Allegation Of Antara Being His And Anuradha’s Daughter. Arti Is Irritated With Antara’s Behaviour. An Enraged Vidya Leaves The House With Her Father.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Vidya Decides To Stay With Her Parents Along With Abhishek. Arti Wants Antara To Go Away. When Aditya Follows Vidya To Talk To Her, Antara Runs Off On The Road Amidst The Traffic.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Vidya’s Mother Asks Vidya To Talk To Aditya. Vidya Does Not Allow Abhishek To Meet Aditya. Aditya Takes Antara To His Office, But She Interrupts The Meeting Enraging His Boss.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Aditya’s Colleague Is Amazed At Antara’s Speed Of Calculating Numbers But Fails To Prove Her Genius To Aditya. Not Finding Abhishek In The School Makes Vidya Frantic.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Vidya’s Father Asks Aditya To Start His Life Afresh Without Vidya And Abhishek. Vidya’s Mother Helps Aditya To Meet Abhishek And Tells Abhishek That Antara Is His Friend.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Vidya’s Mother Asks Her Not To Separate Aditya And Abhishek. Billu Imitates Antara And She Stops Crying. He Tells Aditya That He Does The Same Thing With His Mentally Ill Cousin.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Sameer Postpones His Engagement With Arti. When Antara Tears The Money, Nisha Calls Her Mad And Mrs Gupta Asks Aditya To Send Her Away. Aditya Reveals That Antara Is His Daughter.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Arti Is Angry With Aditya For Telling The Society That Antara Is His Daughter. Abhishek Overhears Mrs Gupta Telling Vidya That Everyone Knows That Antara Is Aditya’s Daughter.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: For The Sake Of Arti, Aditya Requests Vidya To Come Back Home But She Refuses. Mr Kataria Berates Aditya And Calls Antara His Illegitimate Child. An Angry Aditya Resigns.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Munshi Asks Aditya To Vacate The House Or To Raise The Rent By Inr 5000. Abhishek Feels Aditya No Longer Loves Him. Antara Amazes Aditya With Her Speed Of Calculation.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Aditya Receives A Divorce Notice Sent By Vidya’s Dad Without Her Consent. Sameer Asks Aditya To Look After Antara But Keep Her Away From Himself So That Vidya May Come Back.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Mr Kataria Agrees To Give Aditya His Job Back Only If He Would Follow His Instructions Blindly, To Which Aditya Consents. Aditya Checks An Orphanage For Antara.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Vidya’s Mother Tells Vidya That Aditya Is A Good Person And Antara Is Innocent And Thereby Asks Her To Save Her Marriage. Aditya’s Heart Cries To Send Antara To The Orphanage.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Vidya Returns To Aditya And Stops Him From Sending Antara To The Orphanage. Aditya Tells Sameer That Vidya Has Changed. Antara Asks Vidya For Her Birth Date.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Vidya Tells The Society Ladies That Antara Shall Stay With Them. Vidya Tells Aditya That Henceforth, He Will Stay With Antara In A Separate Room And Not With Her And Abhishek.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Aditya Reveals The Situation That Made Him And Anuradha Get Physically Close. Vidya Feels Dejected And Tells Aditya That She No Longer Trusts Him And Is Here Only For Abhishek.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Sameer Suggests To Aditya To Send Antara To Vidya’s School After All Other Schools Reject Her. Vidya Teaches A Poem To Abhishek Which Antara Overhears And Recites It In One Go.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: On Vidya’s Request, Her School’s Principal Admits Antara In Their School. A Principal Of Another School Is In Awe Of Antara’s Talent As She Shows Aditya Her Unique Drawing.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The Principal Recognises Antara’s Talent And Tells Aditya That She Is Different From The Other Kids. Mrs Mehta Asks Antara To Read From A Book, But Antara Remains Silent.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The Society Ladies Stop Their Children From Playing With Abhishek And Antara As They Feel That Autism Is Contagious. Aditya Plays Cricket With Abhishek And All The Kids Join Them.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Billu and Abhishek's mothers realise their mistakes and apologise to each another. Aditya and his family go to a luxurious restaurant for dinner. But Antara starts throwing a tantrum due to which the manager of the restaurant behaves rudely with Aditya, forcing him to leave. However, Vidya refuses to bear this humiliation quietly. The next day, she shows up at the restaurant with a news reporter and several families that have faced a similar humiliation.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: The manager of the restaurant explains that other guests would have objected to Antara's behavior and therefore he could not let her stay there. However, Vidya refuses to listen to any explanations. The manager consults his boss and then asks for forgiveness for his behavior in the past. He also says that they are his special guests and invites them to dine in the restaurant. Aarti calls up Vidya and informs her that she will be visiting her house the next day. Abhishek questions Vidya whether Aarti will be staying with them. Vidya explains to him that Aarti will be staying in Sameer's house after marriage. Abhishek then asks Vidya whether Antara will also move into her husband's home after marriage.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Sameer and Aditya are shocked to learn that Vidya had gone to the bank. Vidya clarifies that she had gone to the bank to fetch Antara. Sameer and Aditya are relieved on hearing Vidya' statement. At night, Antara gets disturbed again and starts crying. Vidya tries to talk to Antara, and succeeds in pacifying her. Vidya assures Antara that she would undergo any test to become her mother and expresses the hope that one day Antara would accept her as her mother.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Aditya's desperate need for cash leads him to take an extreme step. He borrows money from a goon, who warns him against any delay in repayment. Billu's refusal to dance with Antara during the wedding causes friction between him and Abhishek. Vidya manages to pacify them by making Billu realise that nobody understands Antara as well as he does. Meanwhile, Antara's refusal to sleep becomes a grave concern for Aditya and Vidya. They fear Antara's health could suffer due to her behaviour.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Aditya helps the children in the stage play. Through the play, Aditya and the children spread awareness about the true meaning of Diwali. The residents of the society realise their mistake and dispose off their firecrackers. Aditya thanks Abhishek for helping him realise his mistake and for standing by Antara. Vidya returns home and is pleased to learn that Aditya helped the children stage the play. Vidya's belief in Aditya grows stronger and she feels assured that Aditya will pull himself through his current situation.
